# Repository instructions

Follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md). Before helping with downloads, installation, first launch, or bridge configuration, follow the canonical vendor-neutral guide in [`.agents/README.md`](../.agents/README.md), including the end-user-owned TiXL username/root namespace and full first-sync verification. Before operating or troubleshooting the bridge, load [`.agents/skills/blender-tixl-bridge/SKILL.md`](../.agents/skills/blender-tixl-bridge/SKILL.md). Never use Computer Use: use Blender MCP and the TiXL debug bridge, or hand an unsupported step to the end user.
